egress.terms: Static ISP plans: Unlimited Bandwidth and "No Extra Traffic Fees"; the plan is priced by region, rental period and number of IPs.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited for the static ISP product

interface_detail: HTTP(S) and SOCKS5, stated in the Static ISP FAQ. No API is named on the pages read.
tooling: Any client that speaks SOCKS5 or an HTTP proxy, reached from a Worker through a relay that dials SOCKS5. No vendor SDK or CLI is published on the pages read; that is a note on tooling, not a reason to reject.
chaining: The upstream sees the leased address. The vendor labels each sample as Native ISP or Broadcast ISP and defines the difference as whether the IP registration location matches its internet egress; the Broadcast sample is announced by a US hosting network, which does not match its stated Malaysian location.

limits.value: one dedicated static IP per unit, unlimited bandwidth, unlimited session duration, term chosen at order
none for the static ISP product; the Port plan is 6 Mbps per port

binding_note: Bandwidth is unlimited, so the address and its registration class are what bind; the vendor itself prices Native above Broadcast because they differ in registration versus egress location.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers Login with Google or a password form (8-20 characters, letters and numbers) with a Verification code; where the code is sent (email or phone) is unverified: unverified, the code channel. The vendor lists a Telegram contact and an email address for support.

reliability_note: The vendor shows a risk score of 8% and 5% for its two samples; no throughput, ban or replacement measurement was made.
confidence_note: Prices, terms and the two ISP samples are read from the vendor pages on 2026-11-03 and the ASN holders are measured through RIPE. The sold addresses are masked, so no delivered address was looked up.
price_per_tb_month: not applicable: an address, not a byte; from USD 1.80 per IP at the entry price
notes: The domain fluxisp.com answers HTTP 301 to https://zooproxy.com/, so the vendor named FluxISP on the forum source is this vendor under its present name. The two ISP samples on the pricing page are masked (64.93.*.205 and 162.141.*.52), so they cannot be looked up as addresses; the ASN holders were measured instead. AS7361 is held by DataZone Networks LLC and is announced; the vendor shows it under Johor Bahru, Malaysia with the type Broadcast ISP, so the registration holder and the shown location differ.

extras.rung_note: The vendor sells registration class explicitly (Native ISP versus Broadcast ISP) and the sample ASNs were checked with RIPE.
